ethercat._tx_layout_source: bench-servo read-only SDO survey 2026-09-14, CoE 22033/22034: fixed TxPDO 0x1B04 adds signed 32-bit 0x606C velocity_actual and 0x60F4 following_error, and drops 0x60FD digital inputs. On bench-servo on 2026-09-15, physical PREOP readback verified the 0x1B04 assignment for all nine AS715N axes on the first attempt; the nine scanned-cache misses were resolved by the daemon's automatic rescan, with no mailbox retry during the mapping hand-off (docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-15/daemon-8deed804-b04.log:234-347,584-592); the kernel log contained neither 'wrong SDO' nor 'SDO configuration failed' (docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-15/dmesg-ethercat-8deed804-b04.txt:1-60). Owner decision 2026-09-15: 0x1B04 is the bench and robot default at 1000000 ns cycles; select a6ec_1b02 when wired drive digital inputs must be cyclic. Drive inputs on 0x1B04 are mailbox display observations; safety reactions belong to the hardware stop chain and cyclic cell I/O (P6-05). coordinate_evidence._mode_contract: Per-axis coordinate_evidence_mode defaults to multi_turn (standing proof and grace below). single_turn_absolute requires drive-side ratio/rotation-mode startup readback, software ratio 1 and travel strictly below 2*pi rad; three startup comparison/acquisition attempts (unverified retry bound), then PDO tracking with sampled contradictions still faulting. Only Incoherent/Range and Unavailable/Torn rejections spend attempts; faulted drives and unsettled history/cadence/age do not. Exhausted axes stop sampling until Home or a new configuration frame. Mailbox absence or age never invalidates readiness or Home after verification. Owner direction 2026-09-14; docs/evidence/bench-ninemotor-2026-09-13/fixedpdo-e24dea59.log measured fixed-PDO/mailbox behavior under the old multi_turn configuration digests, not single-turn startup.
coordinate_evidence._encoder_loss_signals: The listed 0x2040 absolute_feedback subentries expose positions only; no encoder-loss validity signal is available in this readback. In both evidence modes, statusword 0x6041 fault bit 3 and any nonzero error code 0x603F make readiness faulted without themselves invalidating coordinates or Home. The encoder-specific error code 0x7305 additionally invalidates coordinates and Home (GradientOS docs/resources/a6ec_manual_codes.md, A6-EC fault table: Encoder error). PDO discontinuity and contradictory encoder evidence still invalidate independently.
coordinate_evidence._anchor_tolerance_unverified: Unverified power-cycle and homing origin retention. Restore only when encoder is unchanged within 16 counts and native PDO agrees with saved command modulo W; 16 counts is v4-status.json home_restore_consistency_tolerance_counts. An origin change beyond tolerance fails closed.
coordinate_evidence._unverified: Unverified physical speed 5000000 counts/s, including unpowered backdrive. Acquisition skew must remain below W/2; PDO history preserves intervening turns. Count tolerance 16 follows v4-status.json home_restore_consistency_tolerance_counts=16 with margin over the measured 2-count resting spread in registers-1.log. Qualify at motion limits and rollover on all nine drives.
coordinate_evidence.maximum_physical_speed_counts_per_second: Unverified bound on hand-turn or backdrive motion during inhibited single-turn start-up verification; ceil(speed * mailbox skew / 1000000000) + feedback error must remain below half a turn. Powered 0x607F instead uses the cell drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm (default 3000 motor rpm), per-axis motor encoder counts/rev: one motor revolution is 131072 counts in the drive frame regardless of the electronic gear ratio, so a motor speed cap does not scale with the gear. The powered cap is not compared with this acquisition bound.
coordinate_evidence.start_alignment_floor_counts_source: The former native 50-count independent-encoder Start floor (kIndependentEncoderStartAlignmentFloorCounts), moved to configuration unchanged. Unverified.
coordinate_evidence._source: bench-servo 2026-09-13 fixedpdo-17080976.log and registers-1.log: 0x2040:2B/2D rotation-frame signed64, 0x6064 modulo W. High/low/high bracket rejects low-word tearing before binding; no :29 read. Raw :21/:23 diagnostics have a different scale.
coordinate_evidence._acquisition_unverified: bench-servo sampled-412be4dd.log, 2026-09-13: measured two-upload acquisitions 56000000..83094896 ns (about 83 ms), uploads 24000000..44000000 ns, 0.60..0.67 samples/s/axis. Unverified bracketed acquisition_max = ceil((83094896 + 44000000)/1000000)*1000000 = 128000000 ns. Required age >= interval + N * acquisition_max + diagnostics + margin: 3000000000 = 1500000000 + 9 * 128000000 + 44000000 + 304000000 ns. Diagnostics and arbitration allocations remain unverified under contention. Checkpointed foreign uploads are outside this baseline sum: native-home truth refresh adds up to 9 * 44000000 ns, and startup and mapping readbacks can each insert an upload between sample opportunities. A refresh burst reaches 1500000000 + 9 * 128000000 + 9 * 44000000 + 44000000 = 3092000000 ns before margin; grace covers the resulting transient inhibit for idle axes without a fault if coherent recovery arrives within the bound. start_gap_ns and maximum_start_gap_ns publish sampling pauses. PDO history has ceil(age/cycle)+2 entries; PDO age remains one cycle. Missing, Unavailable, Cadence and Torn publications cannot replace retained valid evidence or renew its age. Sound Cadence/Stale samples with retained PDO history and bounded low-word skew are checked for contradictions in the receiving cycle. For multi_turn only, after age expiry inhibit the affected axis with coordinate_invalid readiness and preserve Home for two sample cadences = 3000000000 ns; coherent recovery restores idle-axis readiness, longer absence or contradictory evidence latches the coordinate fault and requires rehome. Grace writes controlword 0; a moving axis fails closed with FaultDriveReadiness next cycle when the drive leaves enabled. Qualify bracket acquisitions, gaps and recovery on all nine axes.
